messages:
kate (AE): SparrowMed CFO requested a 1-slide exec summary for tomorrow: KMS approach, egress SLA/fallback, and a short commercial fallback. Need by EOD.

sam (SE): Short tech bullets: Private = BYOK (CloudHSM/AKV) with no Redwood decrypt ability; Hosted = envelope-key model (customer wrapping key + Redwood root). HSM in Hosted is exception. mTLS required for peered flows.

net-bot: NET ticket NET-8422 created for peering to 10.12.0.0/22. ETA 24-48h.

omar (Infra): Peering pending. Fallback if delayed: encrypted S3 presigned transfers + SQS ingestion runbook (I'll upload PDF). For guaranteed throughput recommend Dedicated reserved pool.

riley (Legal): I'll need exact KMS sentence & retention clause to paste into the addendum and SOC2 link. Draft: "Private deployments support customer-managed keys (CloudHSM or Azure KeyVault); Redwood will not have the ability to decrypt Customer ciphertext. Hosted deployments support envelope-key integration; inclusion of HSM-backed keys in Hosted requires a written product exception and executive approval." Approve?

sam (SE): Approve. Minor edit: add TLS1.3 in transport bullet.

ana (VP Sales): Commercial fallback to present: (A) Hosted + Redwood-managed envelope keys + 3% security uplift for 12 months; (B) Private + Reserved Dedicated pool with 12% discount on a 2yr commit + migration credit. I'll join the CFO call if they escalate.

kate (AE): Great — actions: Omar uploads runbook + NET-8422 link, Riley finalizes addendum text, Sam finalizes slide bullets, Ana stands by for the call. Deliverables by 18:00 PT today (2026-03-24). Closing thread after assets posted. :white_check_mark:
